sloka: स वृक्षषण्डांस्तरसा जहार शैलान् शिलाः प्राकृतवानरांश्च।बाहूरुवेगोद्धतसम्प्रणुन्नास्ते क्षीणवेगाः सलिले निपेतुः ।। ६.७४.५० ।।
transliteration: sa vṛkṣaṣaṇḍāṁstarasā jahāra śailān śilāḥ prākṛtavānarāṁśca।bāhūruvegoddhatasampraṇunnāste kṣīṇavegāḥ salile nipetuḥ ।। 6.74.50 ।।

translations.english: By the speed of his arms and thighs clusters of branches of trees, mountains, rocks, and common monkeys were attracted, and with reduction of speed along the way the rocks fell.
